meet.speaker: Echo
text: Oh! You're... solid. Nobody's been solid in a long, long time.
I'm Echo. I think I was someone's... something. A voice? A song? I'm what's left over.
You fell, didn't you. Everyone here fell. This is the Hollow Between — where forgotten things go.

trust.speaker: Echo
text: Okay. Okay! Then I'll be worth it.

question.speaker: Echo
text: What I really am? ...That's the question, huh.
When something is forgotten, a little piece stays behind. Like a footprint after the foot is gone. I'm a footprint.
But I think I'm a footprint that wants to walk somewhere.

ignore.speaker: Echo
text: Oh. ...That's okay. People do that a lot. Forgetting is kind of the whole thing here.
Wait — before you go. You should know something.

tutorial.speaker: Echo
text: North is the Whispering Path. It's full of Lostlings — memories that forgot who they belonged to.
They're scared, not cruel. If one attacks, you don't have to fight back. You can TALK to it. Really talk.
When they attack, steer your little light away from the danger. Brushing close without getting hit sharpens your Focus.
Or... you can do the other thing. But everything here remembers what you do. Everything.

ask.speaker: Echo
ask.text: Can I come with you? I don't take up much room. I'm mostly light.

joined.speaker: Echo
text: Really?! I'll — I'll be useful, I promise.
I can mend things. Little things. Memories, mostly. (Echo can be summoned with the SPECIAL command in battle.)

alone.speaker: Echo
alone.text: ...Right. Of course. I'll be around. Echoes always are.

again.speaker: Echo
again.text: You came back! Do you... want me to come along after all?
